description.en: build agents with Claude SDK, MCP servers, A2A protocol, and publish to the marketplace
description.zh: 用 Claude SDK 构建 Agent、MCP Server、A2A 协议，并发布到市场

goal.en: Build and ship AI agents end to end
goal.zh: 端到端构建和发布 AI Agent

outcome.en: Scaffold Claude API apps with the Agent SDK (Python/TS), build MCP servers that give LLMs new tools, add A2A protocol for agent-to-agent communication, publish skills to the Claude Code marketplace, and delegate coding to agents — the full agent builder stack.
outcome.zh: 用 Agent SDK (Python/TS) 搭建 Claude API 应用、构建 MCP Server 赋予 LLM 新工具、添加 A2A 协议实现 Agent 间通信、发布 Skill 到 Claude Code 市场、委托编码给 Agent——完整的 Agent 构建技术栈。

reason.en: Build with the Claude Agent SDK (Python/TS) — streaming, tool use, structured output, subagents, and OpenTelemetry observability.
reason.zh: 用 Claude Agent SDK (Python/TS) 构建——流式输出、tool use、结构化输出、子 Agent 和 OpenTelemetry 可观测性。

en: Build an agent with the Claude Agent SDK
Add tool use and structured output to my agent
Set up subagents for parallel task execution
zh: 用 Claude Agent SDK 构建一个 Agent
为我的 Agent 添加 tool use 和结构化输出
设置子 Agent 执行并行任务

reason.en: Build MCP servers that let LLMs call your APIs, read databases, or trigger workflows — with Elicitation support for interactive agent workflows.
reason.zh: 构建 MCP Server，让 LLM 调用你的 API、读取数据库或触发工作流——支持 Elicitation 实现交互式 Agent 工作流。

en: Build an MCP server for my REST API
Add Elicitation support for user prompts
Create a new MCP server with TypeScript SDK
zh: 为我的 REST API 构建 MCP Server
添加 Elicitation 支持实现用户提示
用 TypeScript SDK 创建 MCP Server

reason.en: Add A2A v1.0 support — generate Agent Cards, enable inter-agent discovery and task streaming, so your agent can collaborate with other agents.
reason.zh: 添加 A2A v1.0 支持——生成 Agent Cards、启用 Agent 间发现和任务流式传输，让你的 Agent 能与其他 Agent 协作。

en: Generate an Agent Card for my agent
Add A2A skill discovery to my agent
Set up task streaming between my agent and others
zh: 为我的 Agent 生成 Agent Card
给我的 Agent 添加 A2A 技能发现
设置我的 Agent 与其他 Agent 之间的任务流

reason.en: Package workflows as skills and publish to the Claude Code marketplace — with proper SKILL.md, tool declarations, and marketplace submission.
reason.zh: 把工作流打包成 Skill 并发布到 Claude Code 市场——包含规范的 SKILL.md、工具声明和市场提交流程。

en: Package this agent as a publishable skill
Audit my SKILL.md for marketplace requirements
Create a namespaced plugin for the Claude Code marketplace
zh: 把这个 Agent 打包成可发布的 Skill
审查我的 SKILL.md 是否符合市场要求
为 Claude Code 市场创建命名空间插件

reason.en: Delegate boilerplate, test generation, and refactors to Claude Code or Codex — so you stay in flow on architecture and product.
reason.zh: 把样板代码、测试生成和重构任务委托给 Claude Code 或 Codex——自己专注于架构和产品。

en: Delegate writing tests for this module to an agent
Have Claude Code scaffold the boilerplate for this feature
zh: 让 Agent 为这个模块生成测试
让 Claude Code 生成这个功能的脚手架

installAll: clawhub install anthropics/claude-api anthropics/mcp-builder openclaw/a2a anthropics/skill-creator openclaw/coding-agent
